_help: Videos are hosted on Mux (dashboard.mux.com). To add or swap a video: upload it in Mux, open the asset > 'Playback and Thumbnails', copy the PUBLIC Playback ID (not the Asset ID) into playbackId. The first video in the list is the one shown first. thumbnailTime = the second used as the cover picture. Mux Free plan: 10 videos max. Account: Crowned Women and Family Community Services (their own Mux account, created 11 Nov 2026). 'hero' is the silent looping film at the top of the home page.
